analysis:
I found no supported security regression in the supplied units. Several conclusions depend on files that were not supplied.

scripts/ci-component-paths.py (head lines 131-135): `full_run` no longer forces every component to run for pull requests into master. Those PRs are now routed by changed paths via `classify`. Pushes to master and workflow_dispatch still run everything. This reduces PR-time CI coverage but changes no runtime control, key, attestation or serving authorization (A-015..A-017, T-052, T-054). The partial `COMMON` list still sends changes to the CI routing scripts and workflows to all components. The new skip behavior depends on the new `ci-tested-tree.py` logic (tree-keyed `ci-tested-tree-<tree>` records, squash-merge handling). Only metadata was supplied for that file, so I could not check record binding, the run-success and fork checks, or whether a poisoned record could skip master tests. A reviewer with the full file should confirm that records are accepted only from successful same-workflow runs, and that a tree-hash match really implies identical content.

docs/operations/provider-release.md is documentation only. It describes a dev-branch release lane that now also has a 6-hour schedule and a manual workflow_dispatch on refs/heads/dev. That lane runs the Developer ID signing and publication chain with `secrets: inherit` and no GitHub environment (lines 499-535). The documented compensating controls are: master's copy of `verify-source`, a current-head and signed-commit check, the dev PR-review ruleset, a bypass list for ref creation, and a secretless gate job on ubuntu. I could not check them because the workflows were not supplied. Signing-key lifetime is documented as import, sign, then keychain removal, with notarization credentials isolated in one step. The pinned-hash AWS CLI install and publication read-only staging are also documented. The dev version ranking quirk (non-SemVer `ReleaseVersionGreater`, lines 549-571) affects only the dev coordinator's latest alias. It does not bypass the self-updater's version-equals-signature check (lines 573-577). Integration should verify the actual release-dev-branch.yml, release-provider.yml and scripts/provider-release-resume.py against these descriptions.
